'''Felucian flying mantas''' were graceful creatures that appeared to swim through the air. They resembled the [[Brith (creature)|brith]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] but were smaller, with a thicker tail, multiple [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and shorter [[Limb/Legends|wing]] span.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''
